descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S01 「现成的 spec：医院 dashboard 数完整的名单并保持实时；列表的 Dashboard 控件能进去」 Existing specs: Hospital dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live; the list's Dashboard control reaches it

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3；TFA-92598 How it works 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently（TFA-92598 How it works 1；TFA-92598 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim's resident test account. 50 filler patients sort ahead of the target (more than one 50-row page), plus one patient in Nursing Home. navigation.spec.ts uses its own fixture patient

When Open /rounding, tap Dashboard. A second client moves the target through pre-rounded, in-encounter, seen, note-ready, post-rounded and a day reset to pending, then removes it and adds another patient. …

Then Total covers all 51 rows. Total = Pending + In Progress + Complete. Each write moves exactly one count while the dashboard stays open (no reload). The Nursing Home patient is absent. The 'Rounding Dashboard' heading shows from the list's Dashboard control, and a row opens /rounding/<that id>

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in both specs. The statuses are written straight through rounding.update, not by Generate or Mark Encounter Complete in the UI, so this is evidence for liveness, totals and the page boundary, not for UAT step 3 as written (S09). …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
